description: This file defines a registration page component for a web application, allowing users to create an account by providing their full name, email, and password. It includes form handling, client-side validation, and routing to navigate to a booking page upon successful submission.

methods.name: RegisterPage
methods.description: React functional component rendering a registration form with state management and routing logic.
